expected_level_description: You can: - run recruitment campaigns through the applicant tracking system - support managers with adverts, shortlisting, and interview arrangements - complete pre-employment checks and make conditional offers

You can: - prepare contracts, variation letters, and employment checks accurately - process changes in the HR and payroll system against deadlines - answer routine questions from managers and staff about HR processes
You can: - explain which skills are hard to recruit and why - share job adverts through the organisation's channels and networks
You can: - enter workforce data accurately in the HR system - explain why workforce data must be accurate and kept confidential
You can: - apply data protection principles to your work - contribute to data protection impact assessments - handle information requests and records correctly
You can: - listen to the needs of design and business stakeholders and interpret information - take part in discussions within a multidisciplinary team
You can: - treat colleagues, patients, and the public with dignity and respect - follow equality and inclusion policies
